title: Project and Supply Chain Management, B.S. (University College)
notes: Pattern B -- genuinely different program from SCM-2026.json ('Supply Chain and Information Systems, B.S.', Smeal College of Business, University Park): different name, different plan code (PSMUC_BS vs SCM-2026's Smeal code), different credit total (120 min here vs SCM-2026's Smeal total), and a materially different course list (this one is built around MGMT 418/MGMT 410/415, SCM 445/460/416/320/455, and MIS 204/301/336/404 -- SCM-2026 is not). Since the two majors don't share a name, this got a fresh code rather than an SCM+BW suffix, per this task's own instructions for the 'no matching UP major by that name' case. Real data pulled directly from the live bulletin page's hidden-but-present Requirements-for-the-Major DOM text (same technique used for PSYCHBA/BS and ITBW): 120 credits minimum (45 Gen Ed, 21 of which are embedded in the 96-credit major; the major's own prescribed-course total plus its real 13-credit 'Supporting Courses and Related Areas' line item). All ~40 real course codes in the bulletin's Prescribed/Additional/Elective-pool lists were verified present in the existing merged catalog -- zero new catalog entries were needed. Multi-option pools were each resolved to whichever real alternative has the shallowest prereq chain (same convention as ITBW-2026.json): 'MGMT 415 (or SCM 416)' -> SCM 416 (needs only SCM 301; MGMT 415 additionally needs MGMT 409/410/BA 421); 'MGMT 410 (or BA 421)' -> MGMT 410 (needs MGMT 301 + SCM 301, both already required elsewhere; BA 421 needs BA 321/322, neither otherwise in this plan); the international-business elective -> IB 303 (no prereq at all, vs. the other five options' various business prereqs); the 'ECON 481/MIS 336/MIS 301/SCM 340' pool -> MIS 301 (needs only STAT 200/SCM 200, already required); the 'BA 422W/BA 462/MGMT 471W' capstone-style pool -> MGMT 471W (its real prereq_groups is one OR-set of MGMT 301/MKTG 301/FIN 301/SCM 301, all already satisfied). MATH 21 is genuinely required (ACCTG 211 and STAT 200/SCM 200 both real-require it, and SCM 301 -- a Prescribed Course -- in turn needs ACCTG 211 + ECON 102 + STAT 200/SCM 200), so it's included as its own item, same placement-gate pattern already used in BUSINESS/ETI/HCDD/ENGRBW/PSYCHBA/ITBW. 'PSU 7 First-Year Seminar Behrend' in the raw scraped text is an artifact of the scraper (PSU is not a real course prefix, and 'Behrend' -- Erie's campus name -- makes no sense on a Brandywine plan) and is modeled as a generic First-Year Seminar slot instead, same convention as every other plan's FYS item. 'BA 241 & BA 242 (or BA 243)' modeled as BA 243 alone (4 credits either way, per the real catalog credit values for both paths -- BA 241=2, BA 242=2, BA 243=4). 'Select 6 credits of 300- or 400-level courses such as MIS 404 and MGMT 430' and the 13-credit 'Supporting Courses and Related Areas' line are both explicitly open/illustrative in the bulletin's own text (not enumerated lists) and are modeled as generic labeled slots.
